instructions: Solve the assigned coding exercise. No tools are available.

input.text: Inputs a and b are packed windows: high byte is start and low byte is positive length. Return bool indicating whether the two half-open windows overlap. Return False if either low byte is zero. Output Python source defining f(a, b), with optional int/bool annotations and no defaults. A single enclosing ```python fence is accepted but unnecessary. Allowed: integer/bool literals, local assignments, if/else, return, comparisons, and/or/not, + - * // % & | ^ ~ << >>. No imports, calls, loops or other syntax. All intermediate integers must fit signed 128 bits; shift counts must be 0..63.

turns.output:
```python
def f(a: int, b: int) -> bool:
    a_start = a >> 8
    a_len = a & 0xFF
    b_start = b >> 8
    b_len = b & 0xFF
    if a_len == 0 or b_len == 0:
        return False
    a_end = a_start + a_len
    b_end = b_start + b_len
    return a_start < b_end and b_start < a_end
```
